title: Global or large-scale expedition program
description: One global or large-scale expedition program that generated marine microbial omics data. One record per file in data/expeditions/.

id.description: Stable identifier, also the filename and the URL fragment on the website. Do not change it after publication.

name.description: Full name of the expedition program.

acronym.description: Short name the expedition is usually known by.

program-website.description: Main landing page for the expedition.

additional-websites.description: Further URLs for the same program, when it is documented in more than one place. The first/canonical URL belongs in the primary website field.

affiliated-institutions.description: Institutions and programs that ran or funded the expedition, as free text.

data-accessions.description: Public archive accessions holding the expedition's molecular data.

data-accessions-note.description: Anything about data availability that is not itself an accession.

sample-metadata-source.description: Where the per-sample metadata lives (BioProject, BioSample, latitude, longitude, sampling depth), including any caveats about how complete it is.

notes.description: Anything else worth recording about this expedition.

accession.description: An INSDC BioProject/study accession (PRJNA/PRJEB/PRJEA/PRJDB), an SRA/ENA/DDBJ accession, a PRIDE dataset (PXD), a GenBank nucleotide accession, or a hyphenated range of either. No archive name, no surrounding text.

contacts.description: People to write to about this expedition.

note.description: Caveat about reaching this person, e.g. that the address bounced.

publications.description: Example publications, preferably data papers. Bare DOI where one exists; URL as a fallback.

verification.description: Who last checked this record against reality, and when.
